answerFramework.label: Situation
answerFramework.guidance: Name only the context the listener needs to understand the stakes.

answerFramework.label: Task
answerFramework.guidance: State what you personally owned, what success meant, and any meaningful constraint.

answerFramework.label: Action
answerFramework.guidance: Explain the choices you made, how you worked with others, and why you chose that path.

answerFramework.label: Result
answerFramework.guidance: Describe the evidence of impact without inflating or inventing measurements.

answerFramework.label: Reflection
answerFramework.guidance: Add what changed in your judgment or what you would do differently now.

storyInventory.title: A successful project
storyInventory.prompt: Choose work where your decisions materially changed delivery, quality, or user value.

storyInventory.title: A meaningful failure
storyInventory.prompt: Choose a real miss you can own without making someone else the villain.

storyInventory.title: A productive disagreement
storyInventory.prompt: Find a case where listening or new evidence changed the path—not merely who won.

storyInventory.title: An ambiguous problem
storyInventory.prompt: Recall how you reduced uncertainty and decided what could safely move first.

storyInventory.title: Leadership without authority
storyInventory.prompt: Use an example where people followed the clarity you created, not your title.

storyInventory.title: Someone you helped grow
storyInventory.prompt: Focus on how you adapted support and increased the other person's independence.

storyInventory.title: A difficult deadline
storyInventory.prompt: Identify the scope or risk decisions that mattered more than simply working longer.

storyInventory.title: A customer-impact decision
storyInventory.prompt: Connect the technical choice to a concrete user problem or trust outcome.

storyInventory.title: A technical tradeoff
storyInventory.prompt: Pick a decision with credible alternatives and a constraint that shaped the choice.

storyInventory.title: An incident or recovery
storyInventory.prompt: Separate immediate stabilization from the later prevention work you influenced.

commonMistakes.title: Too much runway
commonMistakes.guidance: Compress context until the listener can reach your decision quickly.

commonMistakes.title: Invisible ownership
commonMistakes.guidance: Use “we” for team outcomes and “I” for the actions you actually owned.

commonMistakes.title: Activity without judgment
commonMistakes.guidance: Name the choice, alternatives, or tradeoff rather than listing meetings and tasks.

commonMistakes.title: A missing result
commonMistakes.guidance: Close the loop with observed impact, qualitative evidence, or an honest incomplete outcome.

commonMistakes.title: Blame as explanation
commonMistakes.guidance: Describe behavior and constraints professionally; show what remained in your control.

commonMistakes.title: A spotless failure
commonMistakes.guidance: A failure story needs a real miss and a specific change in your later behavior.

commonMistakes.title: Robotic delivery
commonMistakes.guidance: Prepare the structure and evidence, then answer the question that was actually asked.

commonMistakes.title: Borrowed accomplishments
commonMistakes.guidance: Do not inflate team work or invent measurements to make a story sound stronger.

commonMistakes.title: No reflection
commonMistakes.guidance: Show how the experience changed a later decision, habit, or risk check.

finalChecklist: I can explain my personal responsibility without erasing the team's contribution.
Each story contains a decision, action, or tradeoff—not only context.
My outcomes are accurate and I can distinguish measured from observed impact.
I have at least one honest failure and one productive disagreement story.
I can adapt each story to the prompt instead of reciting a fixed script.
I can answer likely follow-ups about alternatives, feedback, and what changed afterward.
I will not disclose confidential details or fabricate an experience.
